command.name: local-compute-router-builder
command.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Implement only Phase A from docs/reverse-engineering/rigspark-local-compute-router.md. Build an independently authored, dependency-free local-compute-capability/v1 domain module plus deterministic Node tests. Implement MachineProfile and WorkloadManifest validation/canonical digests, CapabilityPlan fit|degraded|refuse|unknown semantics, and a separate pure ExecutionGrant contract. Unknown must never be coerced to zero. Capability must never imply authorization. Offload/stage behavior must be explicit. Integrity and loopback-only requirements are non-bypassable. Do not copy RigSpark source/catalog/tests. Do not add network, shell, Git mutation, model download, runtime launch, ComfyUI calls, deployment, or provider writes. Preserve existing behavior and run the narrowest focused tests before returning.'

repairCommand.name: local-compute-router-repair
repairCommand.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Read $SHIPPING_CONTEXT_FILE and $SHIPPING_FAILURE_FILE plus docs/reverse-engineering/rigspark-local-compute-router.md. Repair only the failing Phase A Local Compute Router gate. Preserve fit-vs-authorization separation and fail-closed unknown/integrity/loopback semantics. Do not broaden scope, use network, copy donor code, push, merge, deploy, install models, or execute a local inference/media runtime. Run the narrowest relevant tests.'

goldenPath.description: A known machine profile and workload produce a stable canonical capability-plan digest and fit verdict.
Missing required machine or workload evidence yields unknown and never silently substitutes zero or fit.
A workload that exceeds resident capacity may become degraded only when the manifest explicitly supports an offload or stage-swap path that fits.
A known workload that cannot fit any declared execution path is refused.
A capability plan has no execution authority; a separate exact-digest policy decision is required to create an execution grant.
Unknown/refused plans cannot be granted, and degraded plans require explicit degraded-mode allowance.
Integrity requirements and loopback-only endpoint policy cannot be bypassed by an approval or fit override.
Changed machine observations, workload requirements or plan identity invalidate stale grants rather than silently replaying authority.
Expired execution grants are not reusable after restart and receipt payloads contain identities/digests rather than secret literals.
